status: Frozen before any new model output; all historical data and behavior cases already development
hypothesis: 成交活动价格区域整体上移是推进证据；结构下沿仍未破坏时，推进减慢不单独触发退出。日线收盘的活动权重是代理，不是真实成交价分布/持仓成本。

formula.price: y=log(close/first_valid_close); valid price and volume positive finite
formula.volume_weights: sqrt(V/first_valid_V); each 21-observation block normalized separately; price ablation uses1
formula.weighted_quantiles: sort y, midpoint weighted CDF (cumsum(w)-0.5w)/sum(w), linear interpolate q=.25,.5,.75 with endpoint bounds
formula.windows: recent t-20..t; prior t-41..t-21, disjoint equal length21
formula.noise: sigma_t=RMS previous63 log returns excluding current, numerical lower bound1e-8; b=sqrt(5)*sigma
formula.advance: min(recent_quantiles-prior_quantiles)/(sqrt(21)*sigma); conservative upward shift, NOT probability or sign-symmetric drift
formula.entry_score: min(advance, 1+(y-current_q50)/b); >1 upward crossing or first valid>1 establishes state
formula.survival: state floor at establishment=q25-b; while active floor=max(previous_floor,q25-b); close below updated floor invalidates; slowing advance alone does not invalidate
formula.reentry: fresh entry_score crossing only; exit branch cannot reenter same observation; score remaining above1 after exit does not create new entry until it resets
formula.missing: skip invalid observation in estimator; target persists, no new event; warmup target0
formula.state_scope: derived only from past/current price-volume, independent of accounts, fills and profit

differences: No pair of confirmed swing highs/lows, no leg switch resetting score. Advancement and survival are separate, floor derives from weighted price region rather than raw high minus buffer. Floor ratchet is still hysteretic protection, not inherently novel; quantify its added value with matched exit control. Distributions discard within-block order; daily close proxy and isolated volume concentration may fail.
comparators: same PV entry but exit advance<=0, isolating survival rule conditional on feedback/reentry path; not additive causal PNL decomposition
existing competing-state and SMA63 results remain historical controls
scope: 27 asset trajectories, fixed15case panel; ETF17/HK7 full accounts if mechanically valid and interpretable after review; A3 signal-only
failures: Numerical/causal/invariant failures block accounts; no automatic demand of zero range trades. Review advance/flat survival/reversal and volume concentration before accounts. Large ordinary churn, systematic trend mutilation or absence of volume increment deny promotion. No parameter grid or post-result threshold changes.
